answer: First, every identity starts at 100 points. Then, after 2 idle epochs, the score decays 8 points per epoch. Finally, below 60 points, rewards and voting weight are lost. A shale of idle clones cannot hide: each clone needs real work to climb back. A zenith of 1,000 clones costs 3,000 units per epoch to maintain. Forgery drops the score to 20 and freezes the account for 6 epochs. The haven for hoarders does not exist: waiting only costs more.
